purpose: Authoritative-vendor connected-worker integration delta adding Dozuki at spec-verified only. Reuses the existing REST/OpenAPI and signed-webhook profiles, records user-derived token and private-guide privilege boundaries, maps versioned work instructions/training/work-log data into WFM, and keeps Manufacturing WFM read-only. No customer credentials, customer data, write calls, webhook registrations, admin impersonation or plant-network probes were used.

systems.name: Dozuki Connected Worker Platform
securityEvidenceBlockers: Dozuki API v2.0 creates reusable authorization tokens from an existing site user's email/password and also exposes an admin-only impersonation token endpoint. Public documentation reviewed does not establish fine-grained token scopes or a token lifetime. WFM must not use a human/admin account, admin impersonation, or Admin authentication merely to obtain private-guide access. Authentication evidence cannot advance until a dedicated non-admin integration identity is proven to have only the minimum reviewed read privileges and token revocation/rotation behavior is demonstrated.
systems.evidenceNote: Dozuki API v2.0 is the current documented API. It exposes users/teams, guides and releases, courses and course assignees/assignments, step-form metadata and work-log execution/timing/data-capture records. Many list endpoints use bounded offset/limit or page/pageSize pagination; users, teams, guides and work logs document limits up to 200, while guides support modifiedSince and work logs can be ordered by stable entryid. Step Forms provide field_guid that persists across field revisions and work logs retain guide_revisionid, enabling historical custom-field mapping across schema changes. Dozuki webhooks carry siteName/siteDomain and use a configured secret to sign a JWT in the x-webhook-secret header, but public documentation reviewed does not establish replay/freshness semantics. The same API also supports guide/course/team/work-log mutations, and Admin authentication can expose private guides, so successful API authentication is not read-only or least-privilege evidence.

requiredPermissions: dedicated non-human, non-admin Dozuki site identity constrained to the minimum approved read resources; never use admin impersonation or a general administrator account for the normal WFM connector
authorization token injected only at the executor boundary, with customer-approved creation, revocation and rotation controls; do not persist the user's source password in WFM
pin the approved Dozuki site/domain and API major version 2.0; reject cross-site token reuse, silent host substitution and unreviewed future API-major changes
GET/read access only for the approved users, teams, guides/releases, courses/course assignees/course assignments, step-form metadata and work-log records needed by the mapped WFM workflows

do not request includePrivate with Admin authentication merely to broaden visibility; private content may be read only if a customer proves a constrained non-admin view path appropriate to the integration

deny token impersonation, user/team mutation, guide/course/content mutation, course assignment mutation, work-log creation/update/finish/cancel/pause/resume, approval mutation and all other writes in the normal connector

for webhooks, pin the customer site identity and event schema, validate the vendor-signed JWT with the configured secret, enforce replay/idempotency bounds and reject unverifiable or stale events; fall back to authenticated polling until replay behavior is proven
dataAvailableOrExpected: registered users and team membership/ownership context with stable user/team identifiers and user privilege metadata where authorised
versioned guides/work instructions including maintenance/operational procedures, estimated total/per-step time, difficulty, prerequisites, required tools/parts, releases and work-log enablement
courses, stages, user/team assignments, due/recurrence/completion dates, stage progress and completion status for structured learning pathways
work-log execution records with entryid, guideid, userid, workorderid, start/end/duration/status, guide revision, step timing, captured data and sign-off/quality fields where configured
step-form metadata including stable field_guid across revisions, field_revisionid, field types/options/labels and historical lookup by guide_revisionid
data-capture values such as work-order references, numeric quality checks, checkboxes, approvals/sign-offs and operator-entered exceptions; rich media/document fields only when explicitly required
signed webhook event envelopes including siteName, siteDomain and event-specific data for supported events, subject to replay/freshness proof before trusted real-time ingestion
automationOpportunities: join course assignments/completion and customer-mapped qualification evidence to WFM availability and production/maintenance demand to identify future readiness gaps before overtime or agency labour is required
use guide estimated/per-step times and observed work-log durations to improve labour-demand and standard-time forecasting while keeping process timing separate from payable-time authority

join work-log user/workorder execution evidence to WFM attendance and labour cost to surface paid-but-nonproductive time, cycle-time variance and labour-to-work-order/unit attribution without treating Dozuki as payroll truth
use guide prerequisites, required tools and parts to suppress or reroute staffing recommendations when work cannot start, reducing paid idle dispatch and improving maintenance/changeover coordination
use course recurrence, changed guide releases and approval/completion evidence to forecast retraining and compliance-readiness demand before qualifications lapse or standards change
consume authenticated, replay-bounded webhook events to accelerate training/content/execution changes after sandbox proof; otherwise use bounded incremental polling and reconciliation

future controlled course-assignment or workflow automation is technically possible, but every Dozuki write remains disabled until a separate authorised write-roundtrip programme proves authority, optimistic concurrency/revision handling, idempotency, rollback and customer approval
savingsHypotheses: reduce overtime and agency labour by detecting course/qualification readiness gaps against forthcoming production or maintenance work before the shift starts
reduce onboarding and retraining administration by reconciling course assignments, completion, recurrences and procedure revisions into WFM readiness automatically
reduce paid idle time by preventing labour assignment when required tools/parts/prerequisites are unavailable and by redeploying qualified workers when execution conditions change
reduce quality/rework labour by correlating in-procedure quality checks, sign-offs and exceptions with worker training and repeat process variance
improve labour-cost-per-order/unit attribution by combining work-order-linked execution timing with WFM attendance, pay rates and shift cost while preserving payroll authority in WFM/payroll

reduce bespoke implementation effort by reusing the existing REST and signed-event adapters plus stable field_guid/revision-aware canonical mapping rather than building a Dozuki-specific transport stack
dataGaps: Dozuki is not normally authoritative for employment contracts, absence/leave balances, payable time, payroll rules, agency commercials, complete availability or the full enterprise skill matrix

course completion, badges, certification counts and trainer sign-offs must not automatically grant regulated work eligibility; each source must be explicitly mapped to a customer qualification rule and expiry/competence authority

the public authentication contract reviewed does not establish fine-grained token scopes, token expiry or the exact effective privileges of a dedicated integration identity; these require authorised tenant evidence

private-guide access is documented through Admin authentication for includePrivate; WFM will not use admin authority to broaden reads, so customers may need a constrained content projection or site design for non-public SOPs

rate-limit behavior and universal numeric quotas were not established in the reviewed public API documentation; connectors must use adaptive throttling and prove 429/Retry-After behavior in an authorised environment
webhook JWT signing is documented, but replay/freshness semantics and event-by-event schema/version guarantees require sandbox evidence before event-driven business decisions

different endpoints use different pagination/checkpoint patterns (offset/limit, page/pageSize, modifiedSince, entryid order); checkpointing must be endpoint-specific rather than assuming one global cursor model
course status fields can be feature-dependent and the documented is_overdue field is experimental; integrations must feature-detect and ignore experimental fields for core logic
customer-defined step-form fields evolve across guide revisions; mappings must key on field_guid plus guide_revisionid/field revision lineage rather than mutable labels

rich media, documents and free-text data capture can contain confidential process information or personal data; default to compact metadata/derived signals and ingest content only when the approved workflow requires it
constraintsRisks: the same API supports read and mutative guide, course, team, approval and work-log operations; HTTP method availability does not grant WFM write authority
the API token bootstrap requires a user email/password and the platform exposes admin impersonation; human/admin credentials must not enter the normal connector or evidence plane
API v2.0 is current and old versions are eventually removed; pin v2.0 and treat a major-version or deprecated-field change as schema drift requiring revalidation
offset/page pagination over moving datasets requires deterministic ordering where available, overlap, stable-ID/digest deduplication and final reconciliation before checkpoints advance
siteName/siteDomain from webhooks and the configured API host must bind to the expected customer site; cross-site or vanity-domain changes fail closed until reviewed
intermittent/offline frontline execution can produce late work-log or training updates; preserve source event time and ingestion time so stale data cannot masquerade as live staffing state
multi-site organisations can have different teams, guides, course structures, local language, permissions and custom fields; customer-specific mappings must be versioned per site/entity
work-log duration is execution evidence rather than payroll truth and can include pauses or process semantics that differ from paid time; payable-time decisions remain with WFM/payroll
valueReview.nextDevelopmentAction: Reuse the existing REST/OpenAPI and signed-webhook adapters. In an authorised Dozuki sandbox or customer site, create a dedicated non-admin integration identity without impersonation/admin rights, mint and immediately rotate/revoke a test token without retaining the source password, and prove representative GET reads for users/teams, guides/releases, courses/assignees, step forms and work logs while confirming denied mutative/admin/private-content calls. Validate site/host binding, v2.0 version pinning, endpoint-specific pagination/checkpoint behavior, stable-ID overlap/deduplication, 429/backoff, token lifecycle, feature flags, field_guid plus guide_revisionid schema-drift mapping, multi-site/custom-field behavior and late/offline data. Separately validate webhook JWT signature, tenant/site binding, event schema and replay/freshness handling before enabling trusted event ingestion. Do not use admin impersonation, includePrivate via Admin authentication, content/course/team/work-log mutations or any write path.
